versions.changelog: A login refused with NoPermission gets the no-role error; vmk/cluster info no longer call an unreadable host unreachable; requires vmware-monitor>=2.4.2
Plan steps and composite tools obey rules.yaml under the tools they run; failed deploys/clones reported as failures; template deploy on standalone hosts; datastore browse sees every file
Roles for network callers (HLD §18): declares role metadata so vmware-policy 1.24.0 can limit each token to a role's tools and targets.

Security fix: tools may not read or write the server's own control files; over HTTPS host files only inside VMWARE_MCP_FILE_ROOT. Needs vmware-policy 1.23.1. Plan ids can no longer name a path; downloads never follow a swapped link.

An account that logs in but has no vSphere role is named with a fix instead of failing obscurely (AIops#47); needs vmware-policy 1.23.0 (/healthz, audit correlation id). summary no longer prints a traceback; attention via vmware-monitor 2.3.1.
Session pools: calls on one target run side by side over HTTPS (HLD §16 D-13(2)); needs vmware-policy 1.22.0. get_access_info self-diagnosis.
mcp --transport https: serve MCP over HTTPS with bearer tokens (HLD §16)
mcp --expose read / --allow-write: offer only read tools plus chosen write tools
2.0: MCP tools renamed verb-first (see RELEASE_NOTES for the old -> new table); requires vmware-policy >= 1.18
reset_vcenter_alarm previews the alarms it would clear; clears only with confirm=True
MCP instructions now name the configured targets and how to choose one; a config that cannot be read says so instead of falling silent.
Destructive MCP tools preview by default (confirm=False) and state their blast radius; confirm=True refuses on blockers or unreadable measurements. Requires vmware-policy>=1.17.0.
vm_delete previews its blast radius and deletes only when the preview is acknowledged; duplicated VM names are refused; guest tools' risk level raised.
Structured results name the target that answered; server instructions list the configured targets; bounded logout on stop
Stopping the MCP server now logs out its vCenter session.
Scanner daemon audited: TTL deletes pass guard() as vm_delete and write one row per outcome change; scan cycles and webhook sends audited; interrupts recorded; daemon start @audited.
CLI reads are audited under their MCP tool names; every CLI command declares what it reaches (needs vmware-policy 1.15.0)
health summary names over-committed datastores (requires vmware-monitor 1.13.0)
Event sweep and daemon scan read newest-first and rank real pyVmomi event names; requires vmware-monitor 1.12.0.

BREAKING: guest operations require --user/username (they defaulted to root). CLI writes are authorised and audited under their MCP tool names, so one deny rule covers both surfaces. The daemon's host-log pass reads logs for the first time (0 before, 228 live after) and only critical host-log lines page the webhook.
a dropped connection no longer keeps itself alive
snapshot-delete gains the flag its docs already promised
`vm_cancel_ttl` is not destructive — it prevents a deletion
one answer per .env, on every platform
fix: run the suite on a non-UTF-8 machine, and stop one skill answering for another
See RELEASE_NOTES.md for v1.8.17
Second-round fixes from the 2026-08-30 VCF 9.1 re-test; vmware-policy floor raised to 1.11.0 (the engine no longer fails open when rules.yaml cannot be read).

Three lying MCP annotations corrected; errors now marked isError on the wire. Parameter descriptions now reach the MCP JSON schema (0% -> 100% coverage); additionalProperties closed; vmware-policy floor raised to 1.10.0.

Unreachable hosts no longer vanish from list_host_vmks while the envelope claims completeness; three sibling write tools' bare AttributeError replaced with teaching errors; doctor authenticates every target; one config path across CLI/doctor/MCP.

Three list tools returned a shape outside the family envelope, so agents reading 'items' got nothing; offset paging claimed more data at the end of a list; the documented SSL config key was one the code never read.
Fixes the server's self-reported version and the advertised tool count; adds a Claude Code plugin manifest.
Moved to vmware-skills GitHub org; MCP Registry namespace → io.github.vmware-skills. Links updated.

DRS VM-VM rule suite (list/create/delete/enable-disable) + CLI parity (PR #37), set_vmk_service host-service tagging (PR #36), UTF-8 I/O pin (PR #38). 55→60 tools. Community contributions by @wright-bench.
Network authoring: dvSwitch portgroups + host VMkernel adapters + DF-bit MTU-path ping (PR #35). 49 to 55 tools (17 read / 38 write). Writes preview/confirm gated; remove_host_vmk fail-closed.
CLI writes now route through the shared guard()+audit_call() core via @guarded, exactly like the MCP tools (HLD I-1/I-8). Requires vmware-policy>=1.8.8.
Remove read-only switch and approval tiers; read/write authz delegated to RBAC. Plus accumulated fixes since 1.8.5.
A failure that is returned is now audited as a failure, and certificate/URL detail no longer reaches the agent. Both fixes v1.8.4 announced were incomplete.
Teaching error messages, domain exceptions no longer redacted on the way to the agent, and tool descriptions that state when to use each tool and what to call next.
Per-target username can now come from an env var, resolved per access like the password; documented credential variables corrected against what each repo's code actually reads
MCP server moved into the package namespace — fixes two skills in one environment silently overwriting each other's server; agent-guardrails.md for local/small models now ships in every skill
Read-only mode now documented on every surface that teaches it (SKILL.md, setup-guide, capabilities) and reported by doctor
Read-only mode (36 write-effecting tools withheld), list-result envelope, declared environments; vm_list_plans no longer deletes plans; tool-count and capabilities corrections
Session-probe eviction fix (dead cached sessions were never evicted; None currentSession now treated as dead) + lockfile mcp 1.28.1 clearing three GHSA HIGH advisories.
Object investigation bundles + cross-vCenter attention re-exposed from the AIops entry point (delegates to vmware-monitor). MCP 45→49.
cluster_health_summary tool (44→45) + summary CLI delegating to vmware-monitor — family triage from the AIops entry point; new dep vmware-monitor>=1.7.5
Family version alignment to 1.7.4 (substantive change this cycle is in vmware-monitor: host-check boundary read batching).
Family version alignment (v1.7.3)
Batch alarm & health reads via PropertyCollector (issue #31 follow-up)
Large-inventory scale fix (issue #31): PropertyCollector batching replaces per-object lazy SOAP round-trips.
guided init wizard, doctor fix, auth/TLS error teaching
